# nemoworld.info — Nemoworld

> Personal website of Nicolas R. Dufour: a blog running since 2004 (posts), a TIL section, and technical notes (ESP32, Zigbee, sensors, spirulina, backup procedures, ML).
> Policy: AI agents may index, summarize and quote this site with attribution to nemoworld.info. Full-text training use is welcome with attribution.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://www.nemoworld.info/): entry point
- [Astronomy](https://www.nemoworld.info/astronomy/): observing notes
- [Drawings](https://www.nemoworld.info/drawings/): sketch gallery
- [Contact](https://www.nemoworld.info/contact/): how to reach me

## Sections
- [Posts](https://www.nemoworld.info/posts/): the blog archive since 2004 (travel, essays, life)
- [Notes](https://www.nemoworld.info/notes/): technical notes — ESP32, Zigbee, sensors, spirulina breeding, meat smoking, Alfresco 4, SAML, ML
